top_signals.title: Samsung forecasts record third-quarter profit of $80 billion on the back of AI boom
top_signals.summary: Samsung Electronics reported preliminary third-quarter earnings on Thursday, with operating profit forecast to top 100 trillion won for the first time.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Trump trade chief Greer reports higher cash holdings as law firm pay topped $650K
top_signals.summary: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer reported $1.17 million to $3.75 million in assets and disclosed a prior $10,000 payment from Coupang.
